results.description:
- WHAT IS LOÓNA?
loóna is the first app that lets you quickly disconnect from a long stressful day and get in the right mood for sleep.

- SO, IT'S ANOTHER SLEEP APP, RIGHT?
 Not exactly. loóna isn’t a list of direct go-to-sleep techniques, but rather a mood-altering app that helps you to stay calm during the day and prepares you emotionally for going to sleep in the evening.

- WHY IS BEDTIME MOOD IMPORTANT?
Negative emotions we accumulate during the day are processed and consolidated by our brain during sleep making them more difficult to disassociate from when faced again in the future. Moreover, feeling angry, anxious, down, or, the opposite, excited, and elated, is likely to affect latencies to sleep onset and REM-sleep. People mistake it for the symptoms of a sleep disorder, but in reality, they just may be in the wrong mood for sleep.

- HOW DOES LOÓNA WORK?
From the wake up and during the busy day Loóna will support your emotional states with playlists and immersive stories. Each night you’ll have a recommended escape. An escape is a guided session that combines activity-based relaxation, storytelling, and sounds in a unique way. Complete it to shut the frantic world out, reset your mind, and create the perfect mood for sleep.

Loóna saves your escape sessions to your Apple Health app.

The upgrade to loóna PLUS provides access to the entire collection of escapes. Our subscription options are: 1-month subscription,3-month subscription and  1-year subscription with a 7 day trial, (price may vary by location).

Record important audio events such as snoring, sleep apnea, and sleep talking. Explore trends about your sleep and compare your sleep quality with many Apple Health metrics that affect sleep.

As seen on: 
The New York Times, Forbes, The Guardian, BuzzFeed, The Washington Post, TechCrunch, MacStories, Daily Mail, and many more. Rated as one of the best sleep tracking apps for the Apple Watch and iPhone. 

Join the millions that have discovered the life-changing benefits of great sleep!

TRACK YOUR SLEEP AUTOMATICALLY
- Simply wear your Apple Watch during sleep. Pillow will automatically detect and analyze your sleep.
- View last night's report right on your Apple Watch, along with the heart rate analysis for the night.
- Switch between manual and automatic mode anytime.

BACKUP & SYNCHRONIZE

SLEEP WORLDS: THE MOST BEAUTIFUL WAY TO FALL ASLEEP

Drift off to sleep with unique audio journeys that change every night
With acclaimed actress Hayley Atwell as creative director, who also conceived and voices two of our immersive worlds.

A DIFFERENT KIND OF SLEEP EXPERIENCE

Sleep Worlds isn't meditation or guided relaxation. It's richly detailed storytelling designed specifically for sleep - sophisticated enough to engage your mind, soothing enough to let you drift away. Written by acclaimed novelists and poets, each world gives you something textured to settle into.
Think of it as a game you play by sleeping.

FULLY IMMERSIVE 3D AUDIO

Every world is built in stunning spatial audio. Rain moving around you at the Hotel de Luge. Ocean waves shifting perspective in the Archipelago. The isolated stillness of a mountain cabin at The Lookout. The gentle passing of a toy train through Tiny City. Combined with literary-quality narration, these aren't just soundscapes, they're comforting places you'll want to revisit again and again.

KEY FEATURES:

Star-Quality Narration: Worlds conceived and voiced by Hayley Atwell, plus acclaimed voice talent including Eve Lewis
Literary Quality: Stories crafted by renowned writers including Editor-in-Chief Emily Berry, Joe Dunthorne, and Katharine Kilalea
7 Unique Worlds: Each with its own atmosphere, characters, and stories
Content That Evolves: Every night brings subtle variations - familiar yet always fresh
Multiple Narrators: Choose your favorite voice from up to three narrators per world
Customizable Duration: Set narration from 5 minutes to continuous all-night play
Beautiful Visuals: Subtly changing environments each time you visit

DISCOVER YOUR WORLD

The fog-shrouded villages of the Archipelago (with fog whales). The rain-soaked Hotel de Luge. The mountain solitude of The Lookout. The infinite Archive-of-All-in-All. The global community of Radio Anywhere's CB enthusiasts. The miniature charm of Tiny City. Find your perfect sleep destination.

BEAUTIFULLY SIMPLE

We've stripped away unnecessary features like sleep tracking to create an elegantly simple experience. Just open the app, select your world, and drift away to immersive soundscapes including rain sounds, ocean waves, white noise, radio static, and thunderstorms.
Sleep Worlds is available with a 7-day free trial, currently offering 50% off our full subscription price.

Goodnight, Sleep Worlds.
